# Paul Schwartz

Paul Schwartz may refer to:
* Paul Schwartz (composer), American record producer, composer, arranger, conductor, and pianist
* Paul Schwartz (politician) (born 1940), president of the Jewish Community of Bucharest, Romania
* Paul M. Schwartz, American legal scholar
* Paul Hampton (born 1937), né Schwartz, American actor, singer, lyricist and writer
